brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Provide tidy storage for sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: 4-cell cluster (0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,1,0, -1,1,0) each fitted with compartmented bins: 2x bin hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) at 0,0,0 and -1,1,0, and 2x bin hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) at 1,0,0 and 0,1,0 - total 10 compartments for thread, needles, buttons, scissors etc. Joint bolts at 0,0,0#0, 0,0,0#4 and -1,1#0 lock assembly; meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Compact 4-hex sewing organizer with 10 divided compartments across 4 bins, verified with no mesh clashes and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
